sentences: VS: **legacy (non-NGG) hardware VS, measured** over all 2,236 (`scripts/vs_input_survey.py`): no `exp prim`, no `s_sendmsg` (so no `GS_ALLOC_REQ`) and no `v_mbcnt` in any of them, and every one exports `pos0` and `param`.
The input VGPRs are Mesa's GFX10 legacy-VS layout (`radv_shader_args.c`, `declare_vs_input_vgprs`, not `is_ngg`): `v0` = vertex id, `v1` unused, `v2` = primitive id, `v3` = instance id.

On entry no VS reads `v1` or `v2`; 788 start with the fetch call (see *Vertex fetch*) and read the fetched attributes from `v4` up, and of the other 1,448, 1,052 read `v0` only, 386 `v0` and `v3`, and 10 neither (NGG would have put the VS inputs at `v5`/`v8`, after five GS VGPRs).

**Both ids are zero-based on the hardware**: `v0` excludes the draw's base vertex and `v3` its first instance (Mesa `ac_nir_lower_intrinsics_to_args.c`: `vertex_id` is `load_vertex_id_zero_base`, `instance_id` is `load_instance_id`; the bases come in the `base_vertex` / `start_instance` SGPRs).

Vulkan's `VertexIndex` / `InstanceIndex` include `firstVertex`/`vertexOffset` / `firstInstance`, so the translator seeds `v0 = VertexIndex - BaseVertex` and `v3 = InstanceIndex - BaseInstance` (`DrawParameters`, device feature `shaderDrawParameters`, in every VS's `features`).
GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/vs_base_ids.asm` (`VKH_DRAW=16,7`): `0x101` on every pixel, where `VertexIndex`/`InstanceIndex` alone gave `0x7111`.
`exp pos0` → `Position`, `exp pos1..pos3` → `ClipDistance` / `CullDistance` (and `Layer`/`ViewportIndex` in VS when `pos1` is the misc vector), `exp paramN` → location N.

RDNA2/GFX10 packs clip distances before cull distances contiguously across 4-component `pos` exports (up to 8 floats total), starting at `pos2` when a misc vector (`PointSize`, `EdgeFlag`, `ShadingRate`, `Layer`, `ViewportIndex`; GFX9+ packs `Layer` in `z[10:0]` and `ViewportIndex` in `z[19:16]`) occupies `pos1`, and at `pos1` otherwise (Mesa `src/amd/common/nir/ac_nir_prerast_utils.c`: `ac_nir_export_position`; AMD LLPC `lgc/lowering/LowerInOut.cpp`: `LowerInOut::visitReturnInst`).

Slot assignment follows the DXBC `OSG1` signature (`SV_ClipDistance` = 2, `SV_CullDistance` = 3, `SV_RenderTargetArrayIndex` = 4, `SV_ViewportArrayIndex` = 5, `SV_ShadingRate` = 23), ordered by `(semantic_index, register, component)` with clip before cull; when `OSG1` is absent (or declares none of those system values), `pos1..pos3` exports are discarded.
PS: `v_interp_*` attribute N → input location N.
